snapshot.boundary: This registry is a reproducible offline snapshot of selected primary sources. It is not a claim that an installed framework version is current or that a project has enforced every rule.

standards.title: Proportionate design and useful abstractions
practices: Implement the smallest cohesive change that meets the current requirement; preserve a working modular monolith unless a demonstrated constraint requires more.
Before adding an interface, plugin, generic repository, event bus or dependency, name its current consumer, actual boundary and lifecycle or failure contract.
Use interfaces at real I/O, vendor, replaceable policy or testing boundaries; one implementation does not by itself make a useful boundary unnecessary.
Do not add empty interfaces, pass-through layers or configuration for hypothetical consumers. Do not split a cohesive algorithm to meet a line count.
Keep historical code intact unless the approved change requires migration; apply new-code guidance without forcing a repository rewrite.
decisionFlow: Read the current requirement and existing entrypoint; search for an existing capability before introducing another.
Choose direct implementation, local extraction or a real boundary. State the current consumer and reason for any new abstraction in the existing plan or review.
Compare the simplest viable shape with the proposed shape; remove speculative extension points and unrelated cleanup.
Review the actual diff for unnecessary layers and run the affected behavior tests. Record unresolved design questions separately from passing automated checks.
verification: Review each newly introduced abstraction against a current consumer or testability boundary.
Test the changed behavior and relevant failure path; a short file or passing linter does not establish good design.
boundaries: These are review decisions, not a universal class-count, file-size or interface-count gate.
Use existing task artifacts; ordinary bounded changes do not require a separate architecture document.

zh-CN.title: 适度设计与有效抽象
practices: 选择满足当前需求的最小内聚改动；只有已证明的约束才值得改变现有模块化单体。
新增接口、插件、通用仓储、事件总线或依赖前，说明当前消费者、真实边界及生命周期或失败契约。
真实 I/O、厂商、可替换策略和测试隔离边界可以使用接口；只有一个实现并不意味着该边界没有价值。
不要添加空接口、纯转发层或服务假想消费者的配置；不要为满足行数而拆散内聚算法。
保留历史代码，除非已批准范围需要迁移；新代码规范不授权整体重写。
decisionFlow: 读取当前需求与入口，新增能力前搜索已有实现。
选择直接实现、局部提取或真实边界；在已有计划或评审中说明新抽象的消费者和理由。
比较最简单可行方案与当前方案，去掉假想扩展点和无关清理。
评审实际差异并运行受影响行为测试；自动化通过与未决设计问题分开记录。
verification: 逐项评审新抽象是否服务真实消费者或测试边界。
验证变化行为和相关失败路径；文件短和静态检查通过不能证明设计合理。
boundaries: 不得把类数量、文件行数或接口数量当成普遍质量门禁。
复用已有任务资料；普通有界修改不新增架构审批文档。

standards.title: Cohesive modules and explicit dependencies
practices: Give each module one cohesive business responsibility, a small public contract and an explicit dependency direction.
Keep presentation, transport and persistence details outside reusable business policy; put composition and orchestration at the existing application boundary.
Expose public entrypoints instead of reaching into another module internals. Reject circular dependencies, including transitive project references.
Organize by current business capability and runtime responsibility; a module need not be a separate package, project, process or service.
Reuse actual project boundary checks. A checker for another language cannot prove the current stack dependency rules.
decisionFlow: Read the owning module, its callers, public contract and existing dependency rules.
Identify which module owns each changed decision and which dependency edges change.
Keep a cohesive implementation together and extract only responsibilities with a separate reason to change.
Review public imports or project references, run applicable boundary checks and behavior tests, and record checker coverage limits.
verification: Reject a deliberate forbidden dependency or cycle using the actual project checker.
Test the public module behavior, failure contract and affected consumers.
boundaries: Static import or project-reference checks do not establish cohesion or all runtime dependencies.
Module boundaries do not authorize automatic migration or microservice extraction.

zh-CN.title: 内聚模块与明确依赖
practices: 每个模块承担一个内聚业务职责，提供小而明确的公共契约并定义依赖方向。
把展示、传输和持久化细节留在可复用业务策略之外，在已有应用边界组装和编排。
通过公共入口访问模块，不穿透内部实现；检查直接和间接项目引用，拒绝循环依赖。
按当前业务能力和运行职责组织；模块不必等于独立包、项目、进程或服务。
复用项目实际边界检查；其他语言的检查器不能证明当前技术栈的依赖正确。
decisionFlow: 读取模块、调用方、公共契约与已有依赖规则。
确定每个变化决策的归属及变化的依赖边。
保留内聚实现，仅提取具有独立变更原因的职责。
评审公共引用或项目依赖，运行适用边界和行为测试，并说明检查范围。
verification: 让实际项目检查器拒绝一个明确的非法依赖或循环。
测试模块公共行为、失败契约及受影响消费者。
boundaries: 静态引用检查不能证明内聚性或所有运行时依赖。
模块规范不授权自动迁移或拆微服务。

standards.title: Component composition and capability reuse
practices: Search existing components and capabilities first; reuse the existing state, data-access and output owner instead of creating parallel behavior.
Extract a component for cohesive interaction, independent state, a reusable contract or a separate lifecycle; do not wrap every small function or visual element.
Use typed inputs, outputs and explicit loading, empty, error and pending states. Give each side effect and state transition one owner.
Keep reusable domain decisions independent of a UI framework. Do not reconstruct identifiers, specifications or units from display labels.
Compose small capabilities at an existing entrypoint; avoid duplicate state stores and giant components that own unrelated workflows.
decisionFlow: Search existing components, services and consumers for the same responsibility.
Choose reuse, focused extension or a new cohesive component, and explain that choice in the existing implementation review.
Define inputs, outputs, state ownership, cancellation and resource lifetime where applicable.
Test the consumer interaction and loading, empty, failure and replacement paths; review duplicate implementations across entrypoints.
verification: Exercise a component through its public consumer, including empty and failure states.
Check that different entrypoints reuse the same business decision or protected output capability.
boundaries: Duplication hints and file size are review signals, not proof that extraction is correct.
A reusable component may have one current consumer; speculative future flexibility is insufficient justification.

zh-CN.title: 组件组合与能力复用
practices: 先搜索已有组件和能力，复用状态、数据访问和输出的已有负责人，避免并行行为。
按内聚交互、独立状态、复用契约或独立生命周期提取组件，不为每个函数或视觉元素增加包装。
使用类型化输入输出，明确加载、空、错误和等待状态；每个副作用和状态转换只有一个负责人。
可复用业务决策不依赖 UI 框架，不从展示文本反推身份、规格或单位。
在已有入口组合能力，避免重复状态仓库或承担无关流程的巨型组件。
decisionFlow: 搜索已有组件、服务和相同职责的消费者。
选择复用、局部扩展或新增内聚组件，在已有实施评审中说明理由。
定义输入输出、状态归属，以及适用的取消和资源生命周期。
通过消费者测试正常、空、失败和替换路径，检查跨入口重复实现。
verification: 经公共消费者执行组件交互，覆盖空和失败状态。
检查不同入口是否复用同一业务判断或受保护输出能力。
boundaries: 重复和文件大小只是评审信号，不能证明拆分合理。
组件允许只有一个当前消费者，但假想未来灵活性不足以支持设计。

standards.title: .NET implementation and verification
practices: Confirm the SDK, target framework and packages from global.json and actual project files; keep Avalonia or ASP.NET assumptions conditional on installed dependencies.
Use explicit project references and existing composition roots. Keep domain and calculation policy free of UI, filesystem and transport dependencies where the project declares that boundary.
Propagate CancellationToken through cancellable async I/O, await tasks, and dispose streams, commands and connections with using or await using.
Keep UI state changes on the framework dispatcher; return typed success, empty and failure outcomes instead of overwriting failure with a success message.
Own multi-step persistence or update-and-publish operations within one transaction or synchronization boundary; return values from the effective saved snapshot.
Run the exact solution or test project command. Discovery is not execution or proof that tests exist; record test counts, skips and platform gaps.
decisionFlow: Read actual SDK/project manifests, adjacent implementation and applicable project development Skills.
Map changed public contracts, project dependencies, resource lifetime and state ownership.
Implement the smallest cohesive change, reuse existing ports and add a behavior regression at the real caller.
Run the declared dotnet build/test entrypoints under existing authorization and report counts, skipped tests and unverified native behavior.
verification: Build the actual solution and test the affected test project or solution; confirm nonzero relevant executed cases.
Test cancellation, resource release, transaction failure or dispatcher ownership when those surfaces change.
boundaries: MSBuild targets, imported files and test initialization can execute project code; discovered commands remain declared until their build closure is reviewed.
A build or unit test does not prove native desktop loading, another operating system, real input data or human acceptance.

zh-CN.title: .NET 实现与验证
practices: 从 global.json 和实际项目文件确认 SDK、目标框架及包，仅在依赖匹配时使用 Avalonia 或 ASP.NET 规则。
使用明确项目引用和已有组装入口；在项目声明该边界时，领域和计算策略不依赖 UI、文件或传输细节。
可取消异步 I/O 传递 CancellationToken 并等待任务，使用 using 或 await using 释放流、命令和连接。
UI 状态在框架调度线程更新；返回明确的成功、空和失败结果，不能用成功提示覆盖失败。
多步持久化或更新并发布放在同一事务或同步边界，回传实际生效快照中的值。
运行准确的解决方案或测试项目命令；发现入口不代表执行或存在测试，记录数量、跳过和平台缺口。
decisionFlow: 读取实际 SDK 和项目清单、相邻实现及适用项目开发 Skill。
明确公共契约、项目依赖、资源生命周期和状态归属。
实现最小内聚变更，复用已有端口，并在真实调用方补行为回归。
在已有授权内运行明确的 dotnet build/test 入口，报告数量、跳过及未验证原生行为。
verification: 构建实际解决方案并执行受影响测试项目或解决方案，确认相关用例实际执行且不为零。
涉及相关表面时验证取消、资源释放、事务失败或调度线程归属。
boundaries: MSBuild 目标、导入文件与测试初始化可以执行项目代码；未审查构建闭包前，发现命令仅为声明入口。
构建或单测不证明原生桌面、其他操作系统、真实数据或人工验收。

zh-CN.title: 软件设计与变更验证
practices: 每个模块承担一个内聚的业务职责，并公开小而明确的公共契约。
在应用边界编排流程；界面、传输、持久化和领域策略不得任意相互依赖。
选择满足已确认需求的最小变更；没有当前用途和负责人时，不添加扩展点、抽象或基础设施。
复用已验证的项目能力，避免创建重复的客户端、授权路径或数据访问封装。
每次行为变更都添加或更新最小有效验证，并运行受影响项目命令和 aicg check。
verification: 对变更模块运行针对性的行为测试或类型检查。
生成治理产物或更新技能后，运行 aicg check .。
记录未运行的命令和剩余边界，不作无证据的完成声明。
boundaries: 这些治理原则不能替代官方框架规范。
生成的技能仅声明指引，不能证明代码库已自动实现低耦合或完整测试。

standards.title: Software design and change verification
practices: Give each module one cohesive business responsibility and expose a small explicit public contract.
Keep orchestration at the application boundary; do not let UI, transport, persistence, and domain policy depend on each other indiscriminately.
Prefer the smallest change that meets a confirmed requirement. Do not add extension points, abstractions, or infrastructure without a current use and owner.
Reuse a verified project capability instead of creating a parallel client, authorization path, or data-access wrapper.
For every behavior change, add or update the narrowest useful verification and run the affected project command plus aicg check.
verification: Run a focused behavior test or type check for the changed module.
Run aicg check . after governance generation or a Skill update.
Record commands not run and the remaining boundary instead of claiming completion.
boundaries: These are governance principles, not a substituted official framework specification.
A generated Skill states guidance; it is not proof that a codebase is automatically low-coupled or fully tested.

zh-CN.title: React 组件纯度与副作用边界
practices: 保持渲染逻辑纯净：相同的 props、state 和 context 必须产生相同结果。
渲染期间不得修改 props、state、context 或非局部值。
用户引起的副作用放在事件处理器中，与外部系统的同步放在 Effects 中，并限制其作用范围。
当独立状态、数据加载或业务策略形成独立变更原因时，拆分组件。
verification: 使用项目测试执行器验证受影响交互以及加载和错误状态。
若项目具备类型检查或构建命令，则执行它们。
boundaries: 应用特定版本 API 前，确认已安装的 React 版本。
客户端校验可改善可用性，但不能替代服务端授权或校验。

standards.title: React component purity and effect boundaries
practices: Keep render logic pure: identical props, state, and context must produce the same result.
Do not mutate props, state, context, or non-local values while rendering.
Put user-caused effects in event handlers and synchronization with external systems in Effects; keep effects narrowly scoped.
Split a component when independent state, data loading, or business policy gives it a separate reason to change.
verification: Exercise the affected interaction and loading/error state with the project test runner.
Run the project type check or build when it exists.
boundaries: Confirm the installed React version before applying version-specific APIs.
Client validation improves usability but does not replace server authorization or validation.

zh-CN.title: Mantine 界面组合与表单边界
practices: 重复的视觉决策优先使用组件 API 和共享主题；重复或复杂样式移入局部 CSS 模块或主题扩展。
不要将内联样式属性作为功能的主要样式系统。
每个表单都应具备有类型的值模型、明确的校验错误、等待状态，以及唯一的提交副作用负责人。
取消或替换过期的异步字段校验，并以服务端校验为准。
verification: 测试无效、有效、等待和重复提交的表单路径。
检查变更控件的键盘操作和可见错误反馈。
boundaries: Mantine 描述界面行为，不验证服务端业务规则。
确认已安装 Mantine 版本对样式导入的要求。

standards.title: Mantine UI composition and form boundaries
practices: Prefer component APIs and a shared theme for repeated visual decisions; move repeated or complex styling into local CSS modules or theme extensions.
Do not use inline style props as the primary styling system for a feature.
Give each form a typed value model, explicit validation errors, pending state, and one owner for submission side effects.
Cancel or supersede stale asynchronous field validation and keep server validation authoritative.
verification: Test invalid, valid, pending, and resubmission form paths.
Check keyboard access and visible error feedback for changed controls.
boundaries: Mantine documents UI behavior; it does not validate server-side business rules.
Confirm package style-import requirements for the installed Mantine version.

zh-CN.title: NestJS 模块边界
practices: 每项业务能力建模为功能模块；控制器作为传输适配器，提供者放在模块边界内部。
仅导出构成明确公共接口的提供者，避免将便利提供者变为全局依赖。
授权和用例编排保留在应用服务内，不放入控制器或仓储。
在传输边界执行 DTO 或契约校验，并在返回响应前映射持久化细节。
verification: 通过控制器或应用服务边界测试模块公共行为。
编译 Nest 应用并运行针对性测试命令。
boundaries: 没有项目证据时，不推断多租户、角色或工作流转换。
采用装饰器或平台集成前，确认已安装 NestJS 主版本的指引。

standards.title: NestJS module boundaries
practices: Model each business capability as a feature module with controllers as transport adapters and providers behind the module boundary.
Export only the providers that form a deliberate module public interface; avoid turning convenience providers into global dependencies.
Keep authorization and use-case orchestration in application services, not in controllers or repositories.
Use DTO or contract validation at the transport boundary and map persistence details before returning a response.
verification: Test the module public behavior through its controller or application service boundary.
Compile the Nest application and run its focused test command.
boundaries: Do not infer multi-tenancy, roles, or workflow transitions without project evidence.
Confirm installed NestJS major-version guidance before adopting decorators or platform integrations.

zh-CN.title: Fastify 请求与响应契约
practices: 为路由参数、查询、请求头和请求体定义输入模式；模式是可信应用代码，不是用户输入。
公共端点使用响应模式，确保仅序列化预期字段。
初始校验保持同步且不查询数据库；异步授权或查找放在适当的后续生命周期钩子。
返回稳定且有文档说明的错误，不泄露内部校验或实现细节。
verification: 测试路由的畸形输入、未授权输入和意外字段。
测试序列化响应不包含敏感或内部字段。
boundaries: 模式校验不能替代授权、幂等性或工作流状态约束。
选择插件或生命周期 API 前，确认 Fastify 和 Nest 平台适配器版本。

standards.title: Fastify request and response contracts
practices: Define input schemas for route parameters, query, headers, and bodies; treat schemas as trusted application code, never as user input.
Use response schemas for public endpoints so only intended fields are serialized.
Keep initial validation synchronous and free of database calls; perform asynchronous authorization or lookups in the appropriate later lifecycle hook.
Return stable, documented errors without leaking internal validation or implementation details.
verification: Test malformed input, unauthorized input, and unexpected fields for the route.
Test that sensitive or internal response fields are absent from the serialized response.
boundaries: Schema validation is not authorization, idempotency, or workflow-state enforcement.
Confirm Fastify and Nest platform adapter versions before selecting plugins or lifecycle APIs.

zh-CN.title: 关键 API 完整性、幂等性与重放防护
practices: 添加控制前，根据业务影响识别关键写端点；每次此类请求均由服务端强制授权和工作流状态转换。
可由外部重试的写入必须幂等：将幂等键绑定到已认证主体、操作和规范化请求标识；原子保留首次结果，拒绝同一键对应不同请求。
威胁模型要求端到端请求完整性时，明确签名覆盖组件、允许算法、密钥解析、创建与过期窗口和验证错误；不得自创签名格式。
对重放敏感请求，按操作需要在服务端执行有限有效窗口及一次性或幂等状态；不得信任前端保证顺序。
不得将秘密和签名放在 URL 中，并从日志中脱敏。
verification: 测试有效请求、签名组件被篡改、过期请求以及重放或重复请求。
测试并发重复提交仅产生一次业务效果，并返回明确的重复响应。
测试服务端拒绝无效或乱序的状态转换。
boundaries: 不默认给所有端点添加消息签名；先记录威胁模型和密钥生命周期。
幂等存储时长、规范化和响应语义是需要负责人确认的产品决策。

standards.title: Critical API integrity, idempotency, and replay resistance
practices: Classify a write endpoint as critical from its business impact before adding controls; enforce authorization and workflow-state transitions on the server for every such request.

Make externally retryable writes idempotent: bind an idempotency key to authenticated subject, operation, and a canonical request identity; atomically retain the first outcome and reject key reuse with a different request.

When end-to-end request integrity is required by the threat model, define an explicit signature profile with covered components, permitted algorithms, key resolution, creation/expiry window, and verifier errors; do not invent an ad-hoc signing format.
For replay-sensitive requests, enforce a bounded validity window and one-time or idempotent server-side state appropriate to the operation; never trust the frontend to enforce ordering.
Keep secrets and signatures out of URLs and redact them from logs.
verification: Test a valid request, an altered signed component, an expired request, and a replay or duplicate request.
Test concurrent duplicate submissions produce one business effect and a defined repeat response.
Test invalid or out-of-order state transitions are rejected by the server.
boundaries: Do not add message signatures to every endpoint by default; document the threat model and key lifecycle first.
Idempotency storage duration, canonicalization, and response semantics are product decisions that require an owner.

zh-CN.title: Drizzle 数据访问与事务边界
practices: 查询构造和持久化映射应位于单个模块负责的仓储或数据访问边界内。
仅将必须共同成功或失败的数据库变更放入事务；尽可能将外部网络调用放在事务外。
在用例中明确传递事务句柄，不隐式开启嵌套且不相关的工作单元。
使用数据库约束和冲突处理保证并发正确性，不仅依赖事前读取。
verification: 测试多步写入失败时的回滚。
针对相关唯一约束或状态约束，测试重复和并发写入。
boundaries: 根据有文档记录的业务不变量选择隔离级别和重试行为，不套用通用默认值。
Drizzle 事务支持取决于已安装的数据库驱动及版本。

standards.title: Drizzle data access and transaction boundaries
practices: Keep query construction and persistence mapping in a repository or data-access boundary owned by one module.
Wrap only the database changes that must succeed or fail together in a transaction; keep external network calls outside the transaction when possible.
Pass the transaction handle through the use case explicitly instead of silently starting nested, unrelated units of work.
Use database constraints and conflict handling for correctness that must hold under concurrency; do not rely only on a prior read.
verification: Test rollback on a failing multi-step write.
Test duplicate and concurrent writes against the relevant unique or state constraint.
boundaries: Choose isolation level and retry behavior from a documented business invariant, not from a generic default.
Drizzle transaction support depends on the installed database driver and version.

zh-CN.title: PostgreSQL 并发不变量
practices: 为关键操作选择锁、约束、隔离级别或重试策略前，先明确并发不变量。
适当使用唯一约束、条件更新和行锁，避免正确性依赖读写时序。
选定隔离级别可能产生序列化失败或冲突时，明确处理这些结果。
将序列值视为标识符，不作为可回滚业务事件或无间隙计数器。
verification: 运行试图违反不变量的并发测试。
在真实的 PostgreSQL 兼容测试环境验证回滚、冲突和重试行为。
boundaries: PostgreSQL 默认值和行为不能替产品决定冲突策略。
生产规模、连接池配置和迁移顺序需要环境专属证据。

standards.title: PostgreSQL concurrency invariants
practices: State the concurrency invariant for a critical operation before choosing locks, constraints, isolation, or retries.
Use unique constraints, conditional updates, and row locking where appropriate so correctness does not depend on timing between reads and writes.
Handle serialization failures or conflict outcomes explicitly when the selected isolation level can produce them.
Treat sequence values as identifiers, not as rolled-back business events or gap-free counters.
verification: Run a concurrent test that attempts to violate the invariant.
Verify rollback, conflict, and retry behavior with the real PostgreSQL-compatible test environment.
boundaries: PostgreSQL defaults and behavior do not decide product conflict policy for you.
Production scale, pool configuration, and migration sequencing need environment-specific evidence.

zh-CN.title: Socket.IO 实时事件契约
practices: 在一个共享边界内定义有版本的事件名称及有类型的载荷和确认契约。
服务端授权房间成员资格，并根据已验证的租户、用户或实体所有权推导房间名；房间不构成客户端授权机制。
需要明确结果的命令使用确认和超时语义；允许客户端重试时，处理器必须幂等。
仅对允许丢失的最新状态信号使用 volatile 事件，不用于必须交付的业务状态。
verification: 测试未授权加入房间和跨租户广播尝试。
测试确认超时、重连、重复命令和事件版本兼容行为。
boundaries: Socket.IO 交付机制不能替代持久化领域事件或可靠任务队列。
多服务器扩展需要明确的适配器和交付语义决策。

standards.title: Socket.IO realtime event contracts
practices: Define versioned event names and typed payload/acknowledgement contracts in one shared boundary.
Authorize room membership on the server and derive room names from validated tenant, user, or entity ownership; rooms are not a client authorization primitive.
Use acknowledgement and timeout semantics for commands that need a known result; make command handlers idempotent if clients can retry.
Use volatile events only for intentionally lossy latest-state signals, never for business state that must be delivered.
verification: Test unauthorized room join and cross-tenant broadcast attempts.
Test acknowledgement timeout, reconnect, duplicate command, and event-version compatibility behavior.
boundaries: Socket.IO delivery does not replace persisted domain events or a durable job queue.
Multi-server scaling needs a deliberate adapter and delivery-semantics decision.

zh-CN.title: LiveKit 令牌与媒体授权边界
practices: 仅在可信后端完成用户与房间成员授权后签发访问令牌；不得向浏览器或移动端暴露 API 秘密。
每个令牌仅具备当前操作所需的最小权限、房间身份和较短有效期。
房间创建、参与者授权和应用业务状态保留在后端领域边界，不信任客户端房间输入。
审计令牌签发，但不记录原始令牌或秘密。
verification: 测试未授权用户无法获取或使用房间令牌。
测试权限缩减、过期令牌拒绝和有效参与者加入路径。
boundaries: LiveKit 权限控制媒体访问，不能替代业务数据的应用层授权。
令牌 TTL、身份格式和房间生命周期必须由产品安全设计负责。

standards.title: LiveKit token and media authorization boundaries
practices: Mint access tokens only on a trusted backend after authorizing the user and room membership; never expose API secrets to a browser or mobile client.
Give each token the minimum grants, room identity, and short validity required for the current operation.
Keep room creation, participant authorization, and application business state in the backend domain boundary rather than trusting client room input.
Audit token issuance without recording raw tokens or secrets.
verification: Test that an unauthorized user cannot obtain or use a room token.
Test reduced grants, expired token rejection, and a valid participant join path.
boundaries: LiveKit grants control media access; they do not replace application-level authorization for business data.
Token TTL, identity format, and room lifecycle must be owned by the product security design.

zh-CN.title: Redis 交付语义与所有权
practices: 根据交付和恢复要求选择 Redis 数据结构，不仅考虑便利性。
仅在可接受断连期间丢失时使用 Pub/Sub；需要重放、恢复或消费组协调时，使用 Streams 等持久机制。
与负责模块共同定义键所有权、TTL、序列化、重试和清理规则。
除非产品明确接受该持久性模型，否则不将 Redis 作为不可逆业务状态的事实来源。
verification: 根据声明的交付保证测试断连、重启、重复和消费者恢复行为。
测试 TTL 或保留策略清理不会删除其他模块的键命名空间。
boundaries: Redis 拓扑、持久化和集群行为需要部署专属验证。
至少一次交付仍要求消费者保持幂等。

standards.title: Redis delivery semantics and ownership
practices: Choose Redis data structures by delivery and recovery requirements, not by convenience.
Use Pub/Sub only when loss during disconnection is acceptable; use a durable mechanism such as Streams when consumers need replay, recovery, or consumer-group coordination.
Define key ownership, TTL, serialization, retry, and cleanup together with the owning module.
Do not treat Redis as the source of truth for irreversible business state unless the product explicitly accepts that durability model.
verification: Test disconnect, restart, duplicate, and consumer recovery behavior for the declared delivery guarantee.
Test TTL or retention cleanup without deleting another module's key namespace.
boundaries: Redis topology, persistence, and cluster behavior require deployment-specific validation.
At-least-once delivery still requires idempotent consumers.

zh-CN.title: BullMQ 幂等任务处理
practices: 确保每个任务可安全运行多次，并聚焦于小型、可观测的工作单元。
根据操作的交付契约选择尝试次数、退避、超时、保留和去重模式；不惯性启用重试。
在业务边界持久化或推导幂等标识，防止重复处理造成重复效果。
区分可重试的暂时故障与永久校验或授权失败，并记录操作人员可见的结果。
verification: 测试重复入队、部分失败后的重试和最终失败路径。
测试保留与去重设置不会无声允许重复业务效果。
boundaries: 仅靠队列重试不能使外部副作用幂等。
生产工作进程并发和可观测性需要明确的运维负责人。

standards.title: BullMQ idempotent job processing
practices: Make each job safe to run more than once and keep one job focused on a small, observable unit of work.
Choose attempts, backoff, timeout, retention, and deduplication mode from the operation's delivery contract; do not enable retries by habit.
Persist or derive an idempotency identity at the business boundary so duplicate processing cannot create duplicate effects.
Separate retryable transient failures from permanent validation or authorization failures and record an operator-visible outcome.
verification: Test duplicate enqueue, retry after a partial failure, and the terminal failure path.
Test that retention and deduplication settings do not silently permit a duplicate business effect.
boundaries: Queue retries alone do not make external side effects idempotent.
Production worker concurrency and observability need operational ownership.

zh-CN.title: 标准 Skill 编写与审计
triggers: 创建、更新、拆分或评审仓库 Skill。
生成的 Skill 过于宽泛、只有文字描述、无法准确路由或缺少实施指导。
nonTriggers: 不要为一次性任务或尚未确认的业务偏好创建 Skill。
没有证据绑定的负责人决定时，不得提升项目候选。
decisionFlow: 定义一个稳定的决策表面，并写出具体命中与不命中的任务。
选择实现型或工作流型质量档案，补齐所有必需章节与证据来源。
实现型 Skill 提供中性的正确与错误代码形状；工作流型 Skill 的每一步写明可执行动作、可观察输出与进入下一步的条件。
把场景验证绑定到已发现的仓库命令；没有可信命令时明确标记尚未验证。
发布或采纳前运行质量审计与路由测试。
practices: 先声明明确触发条件与非触发条件，避免按技术名词无条件加载。
实现型 Skill 必须给出不变量、决策流程、正确与错误代码形状、例外和项目证据边界。
验证必须使用场景矩阵，绑定真实仓库命令；没有可信命令时明确标记尚未验证。
通用标准使用中性示例，真实业务端点、类名、表名和事故细节只能留在项目证据中。
一个 Skill 只负责一个稳定决策表面；路由 Skill 负责组合，不把整个技术栈塞进一个文件。
入口保留共用决策；较长的分支专用内容通过明确写出触发条件的引用按需加载。命中分支仍须包含完整规则和可执行示例。
每个工作流步骤写明可观察输出与进入下一步的条件。复用已有审批点，不增加重复确认。
先查询仓库事实，复用已确认选择；只询问前置条件已明确、且会影响结果的未决事项。
每条共用规则只有一个权威来源。复用项目术语表，只记录有实际取舍的重要设计决定；有内容需要沉淀时才创建记录。
除非用户要求，否则保留客户端调用策略；前置元数据的行为须按实际支持的客户端验证。
每次实现并验证一个完整行为，通过相关公共接口观察结果，预期结果来自需求或独立演算，避免照抄实现。
verification: 运行 Skill 质量审计，确认所有必需章节、决策步骤与验证矩阵存在。
用命中和不命中任务各做一次路由测试。
用正确、错误和例外案例验证 Skill 能指导实际实现与评审。
boundaries: 章节齐全不等于内容正确；仍需官方来源与项目证据。
不得把未批准的项目候选直接提升为标准。

standards.title: Standard Skill authoring and audit

sources.title: AI Code Governance Skill quality contract

triggers: Create, update, split, or review a repository Skill.
A generated Skill is too broad, descriptive-only, unroutable, or lacks implementation guidance.
nonTriggers: Do not create a Skill for one transient task or an unconfirmed business preference.
Do not promote a project candidate without an evidence-bound owner decision.
decisionFlow: Define one stable decision surface and write concrete trigger and non-trigger cases.
Choose an implementation or workflow profile, then supply every required section and evidence source.
For implementation Skills, add neutral correct and incorrect code shapes; for workflows, give each step an executable action, observable output and advance condition.
Bind scenario-based verification to discovered repository commands or mark it not yet verified.
Run the quality audit and route tests before publishing or adopting the Skill.
practices: State concrete trigger and non-trigger conditions instead of loading a Skill from a technology keyword alone.
An implementation Skill must include invariants, a decision flow, correct and incorrect code shapes, exceptions, and a project evidence boundary.
Use a scenario verification matrix bound to real repository commands; mark it not yet verified when no trusted command exists.
Keep reusable standards neutral; real business endpoints, classes, tables, and incident details belong only in project evidence.
Give one Skill one stable decision surface; compose them through a router instead of putting an entire stack in one file.

Keep shared decisions in the entrypoint and load substantial branch-specific references only through a pointer that states its trigger. Preserve complete rules and worked examples on the selected branch.
Give every workflow step an observable output and an advance condition. Reuse existing approval points instead of creating another ceremony.
Look up repository facts before asking; reuse confirmed choices and ask only material decisions whose prerequisites are settled.
Keep each reusable rule in one authoritative source. Reuse the project glossary and record only consequential design trade-offs; create these records only when needed.
Preserve client invocation policy unless requested otherwise; frontmatter behavior needs verification in each supported client.
Build and verify one complete behavior at a time through the relevant public interface. Derive expected results independently of the implementation.
verification: Run the Skill quality audit and confirm all required sections, decisions, and matrix fields are present.
Exercise one matching and one non-matching task to verify routing.
Use correct, incorrect, and exception cases to confirm the Skill guides implementation and review.
boundaries: Complete sections do not prove technical correctness; official sources and project evidence are still required.
Never promote an unapproved project candidate into a standard.

zh-CN.title: 专业测试与模拟真人测试
triggers: 客户要求测试、验证、质量保障、验收或实际操作某项产品行为。
交付需要规划自动化检查、模拟真人测试或真实用户研究。
nonTriggers: 普通编译或静态检查不能视为模拟真人测试。
没有客户明确授权时，不得招募、联系或观察真实用户。
decisionFlow: 接收开发交接，确认测试范围、版本、环境、角色和停止条件。
从已确认需求、开发文档、契约和代码风险生成稳定 Case ID 的 schema v2 用例清单。
测试前校验基线与执行清单，再按 Case、优先级、标签或驱动生成只含当前上下文的最小 AI 执行包。
执行 browser、API、device、terminal 或 mixed 用例；PASS/FAIL 必须关联真实存在且计算摘要的证据文件。
把结果原子写入证据账本，未返回用例补为 NOT_RUN，并从账本生成报告。
若需要模拟真人测试，根据产品表面、风险、无障碍、设备和网络环境推荐测试人员角色及真实用户群体。
分别报告自动化、模拟真人与真实用户证据，并列出未执行场景和剩余风险。
practices: 开发、测试与报告角色必须明确交接物；测试不得从未绑定版本的自然语言摘要开始。
用例 ID 一经发布保持稳定；角色、环境和测试数据集中复用，执行时每次只加载当前 Case 与它引用的上下文。
执行包必须绑定范围、基线、清单摘要和自身摘要；结果账本以会话 ID 幂等写入，并拒绝同 ID 不同内容。
PASS 和 FAIL 必须关联真实证据；证据记录路径、内容摘要和字节数，缺失证据不得判定通过或失败。
客户提出测试时，确认是否需要模拟真人测试；普通自动化测试不因等待此可选答案而停止。
需要模拟真人测试时，推荐质量工程师、领域专家、可用性或无障碍测试者，以及匹配目标设备和网络的覆盖角色。
同时推荐真实用户画像：新用户、高频用户、边界场景用户、无障碍需求用户及目标设备或网络用户；不得编造身份或声称已经招募。
把自动化验证、模拟真人走查和真实用户研究分别报告，不得互相替代。
联系、招募、记录或补偿真实用户前，必须取得客户明确授权，并确认隐私、同意与数据保留边界。
verification: 校验 schema v2 清单的稳定 ID、共享上下文、覆盖决策和自动化驱动。
确认每个 PASS/FAIL 都有可读取且摘要匹配的证据，未返回用例被标记为 NOT_RUN。
重放同一会话应保持幂等，同会话不同结果必须被拒绝。
从账本生成中文或英文报告，并确认自动化、模拟真人与真实用户证据严格分开。
boundaries: 模拟真人测试不是已经完成真实用户验证的证明。
治理框架只能推荐角色和用户画像；不得在没有客户授权时联系或招募人员。

standards.title: Professional testing and human-simulation planning

sources.title: AI Code Governance professional testing workflow

triggers: The customer asks to test, verify, QA, accept, or exercise a product behavior.
A delivery needs automated checks, simulated human testing, or real-user research planning.
nonTriggers: Do not treat an ordinary compile or static check as human-simulation testing.
Do not recruit, contact, or observe real users without explicit customer authorization.
decisionFlow: Accept the development handoff and confirm scope, version, environment, roles, and stop conditions.
Generate a schema-v2 case manifest with stable Case IDs from confirmed requirements, development documentation, contracts, and code risks.
Validate the baseline and manifest, then select a minimal AI packet by Case, priority, tag, or driver containing only referenced context.
Execute browser, API, device, terminal, or mixed cases; PASS and FAIL require real evidence files with recorded digests.
Atomically append results to the evidence ledger, fill omitted cases as NOT_RUN, and generate the report from the ledger.
If human simulation is selected, recommend tester roles and real-user cohorts matching product surface, risk, accessibility, device, and network context.
Report automated, simulated-human, and real-user evidence separately, including unexecuted cases and residual risk.
practices: Development, testing, and reporting roles must have explicit handoff artifacts; testing never starts from an unversioned prose summary.
Published Case IDs remain stable; actors, environments, and data are shared, and each execution loads only the current Case and referenced context.
Execution packets bind scope, baseline, manifest digest, and packet digest; the result ledger writes session IDs idempotently and rejects changed content under the same ID.
PASS and FAIL require existing evidence; record each evidence path, content digest, and byte count.
Ask whether simulated human testing is required without blocking safe automated verification on that optional answer.
For human simulation, recommend a quality engineer, domain specialist, usability or accessibility tester, and target device or network coverage roles.
Recommend real-user cohorts such as first-time, frequent, edge-case, accessibility, and target-device or network users; never fabricate identities or claim recruitment occurred.
Report automated verification, simulated-human walkthroughs, and real-user research separately; none substitutes for another.
Obtain explicit customer authorization and confirm consent, privacy, and retention boundaries before contacting, recruiting, recording, or compensating real users.
verification: Validate stable IDs, shared context, coverage decisions, and automation drivers in the schema-v2 manifest.
Confirm every PASS/FAIL has readable digest-matching evidence and omitted cases become NOT_RUN.
Replay of an identical session is idempotent and changed results under one session ID are rejected.
Generate the selected-language report from the ledger and keep automated, simulated-human, and real-user evidence separate.
boundaries: Simulated human testing is not proof that real-user validation occurred.
Governance may recommend roles and user cohorts, but must not contact or recruit people without customer authorization.

zh-CN.title: Spring MVC HTTP 契约
practices: 普通 JSON 请求使用具名 DTO、@RequestBody 与 @Valid，并保持稳定的响应 DTO。
控制器只处理传输映射；跨字段校验、授权、状态转换和事务在服务边界执行。
显式定义错误语义，不向客户端泄露持久化对象或内部异常。
verification: 测试有效、缺字段、非法字段和未授权请求。
测试响应和错误契约不泄露内部字段。
boundaries: 表单和 multipart 输入应根据 Servlet 语义单独建模。
项目专属鉴权、租户和错误封装必须由仓库证据确认。

standards.title: Spring MVC HTTP contracts
practices: Use named DTOs with @RequestBody and @Valid for ordinary JSON requests, and return stable response DTOs.
Keep controllers at the transport boundary; perform cross-field validation, authorization, state transitions, and transactions in services.
Define error semantics explicitly and never expose persistence records or internal exceptions directly.
verification: Test valid, missing-field, invalid-field, and unauthorized requests.
Test that response and error contracts do not expose internal fields.
boundaries: Model form and multipart input separately according to Servlet semantics.
Project-specific authentication, tenancy, and error envelopes require repository evidence.

zh-CN.title: Spring 服务与事务边界
practices: 在应用服务中编排授权、状态转换和必须共同成功的持久化写入。
明确回滚、传播、隔离和外部副作用边界；网络调用尽量置于数据库事务外。
验证代理语义，不能假设同类自调用会触发 @Transactional。
verification: 测试成功、回滚、并发冲突和重复调用。
测试目标方法确实通过事务代理调用。
boundaries: 事务注解本身不能证明运行时事务已启用。
隔离级别与重试规则必须由业务不变量决定。

standards.title: Spring service and transaction boundaries
practices: Orchestrate authorization, state transitions, and persistence writes that must succeed together in an application service.
State rollback, propagation, isolation, and external-effect boundaries explicitly; keep network calls outside database transactions when possible.
Verify proxy semantics instead of assuming that same-class self-invocation activates @Transactional.
verification: Test success, rollback, concurrency conflict, and duplicate invocation.
Test that the target method is actually invoked through a transaction proxy.
boundaries: A transaction annotation alone does not prove that runtime transaction management is active.
Isolation and retry rules must follow confirmed business invariants.

zh-CN.title: MyBatis 持久化边界
practices: Mapper 方法使用具名参数和明确返回类型，并让 XML statement id 与接口契约对应。
动态 SQL 仅拼装受控结构；用户输入必须作为绑定参数。
并发正确性依赖数据库约束或带期望状态的条件更新，不只依赖先查后写。
verification: 测试空结果、多结果、动态条件和字段映射。
测试重复或并发写入不会违反不变量。
boundaries: 生成器不得从表名推断业务语义。
缓存、批处理和插件行为需要项目配置证据。

standards.title: MyBatis persistence boundaries
practices: Use named mapper parameters and explicit return types, with XML statement ids aligned to interface contracts.
Use dynamic SQL only for controlled structure; keep user input in bound parameters.
Enforce concurrency invariants with database constraints or conditional updates that include the expected state, not only read-before-write checks.
verification: Test empty, multiple, dynamic-condition, and result-mapping cases.
Test duplicate or concurrent writes cannot violate the invariant.
boundaries: Do not infer business semantics from table names.
Cache, batching, and plugin behavior require project configuration evidence.

zh-CN.title: Vue 组件组合
practices: 组件使用有类型的 props 和 emits；可复用状态与副作用进入可测试 composable。
明确加载、空、错误和等待状态，避免在渲染期间修改外部状态。
组件只负责一个界面职责，跨页面策略进入领域或状态层。
verification: 测试主要交互及加载、空和错误状态。
运行项目类型检查与组件测试。
boundaries: 确认项目使用 Options API 还是 Composition API。
客户端校验不能替代服务端校验。

standards.title: Vue component composition
practices: Use typed props and emits; move reusable state and effects into testable composables.
Represent loading, empty, error, and pending states explicitly, and do not mutate external state during render.
Give a component one UI responsibility and move cross-page policy to a domain or state boundary.
verification: Test the primary interaction plus loading, empty, and error states.
Run the project type check and component test command.
boundaries: Confirm whether the project standardizes the Options API or Composition API.
Client validation does not replace server validation.

zh-CN.title: Vue API 客户端契约
practices: 通过领域局部 API 模块集中请求、DTO 和错误映射。
复用项目 HTTP 客户端、授权和错误封装，不创建平行 fetch/axios 路径。
可被路由或新请求替换的调用应支持取消并忽略过期结果。
verification: 测试成功、服务端错误、取消和过期响应。
类型检查请求与响应 DTO 的调用点。
boundaries: 端点、Header 和错误码必须来自项目契约证据。
不得把真实业务路径写入通用治理模板。

standards.title: Vue API client contracts
practices: Centralize requests, DTOs, and error mapping in domain-local API modules.
Reuse the project HTTP client, authorization, and error envelope instead of creating a parallel fetch or axios path.
Support cancellation and ignore stale results when a route or newer request can supersede an in-flight request.
verification: Test success, server error, cancellation, and stale-response behavior.
Type-check request and response DTO call sites.
boundaries: Endpoints, headers, and error codes must come from project contract evidence.
Never copy real business paths into a reusable governance template.

zh-CN.title: Pinia 状态与路由边界
practices: Store 保存跨组件共享的领域状态与动作，不保存 DOM、路由对象或临时表单细节。
路由负责导航和访问入口；授权仍由服务端执行。
刷新或注销时显式清理用户作用域状态。
verification: 测试 Store 动作、失败恢复、刷新与注销清理。
测试路由守卫的允许、拒绝和直接 URL 访问。
boundaries: 是否持久化状态必须由数据敏感性和产品需求决定。
前端路由守卫不能作为唯一授权控制。

standards.title: Pinia state and routing boundaries
practices: Keep cross-component domain state and actions in stores; do not store DOM nodes, router objects, or transient form details.
Use routing for navigation and access entrypoints while keeping authorization enforced by the server.
Clear user-scoped state explicitly on refresh recovery or logout.
verification: Test store actions, failure recovery, refresh, and logout cleanup.
Test allowed, denied, and direct-URL route-guard paths.
boundaries: Persist state only when product need and data sensitivity justify it.
A frontend route guard is never the sole authorization control.

zh-CN.title: Taro 与 React Native 多端边界
practices: 共享领域契约，平台 API 通过窄适配器隔离。
每个目标分别声明能力、权限、存储和生命周期差异。
不要假设小程序、H5 与原生端具备相同全局对象或后台行为。
verification: 至少在每个受影响目标运行构建或测试。
测试权限拒绝、后台恢复和不支持能力的降级。
boundaries: 单端通过不能证明其他目标正确。
设备和系统版本行为需要真机证据。

standards.title: Taro and React Native target boundaries
practices: Share domain contracts while isolating platform APIs behind narrow adapters.
Declare capability, permission, storage, and lifecycle differences for each target explicitly.
Do not assume mini-program, web, and native targets expose the same globals or background behavior.
verification: Run a build or test for every affected target.
Test permission denial, background recovery, and unsupported-capability fallback.
boundaries: Passing on one target does not prove correctness on another.
Device and OS-version behavior requires real-device evidence.
